results.rationale: Provided capability records relate to network design/cybersecurity rather than SCADA/IoT remote monitoring with a centralized multi-site web dashboard, so evidence is only adjacent.
No evidence shows in-house power engineering capability for grid interconnection studies or protection coordination; retrieved records are for bridge engineering.
Solar Energy project experience supports credibility to comply with IEC/Pakistan Electricity Code, but no record/profile explicitly references IEC 62548 or Pakistan Electricity Code compliance.
Company profile shows 4 PE-registered engineers which supports availability of licensed personnel, but it does not map clearly to the specific installation-team licensing required by the RFP clause.
Company profile explicitly states quarterly preventive maintenance and 24–48 hour response SLAs, matching the required quarterly visits and 48-hour fault-response commitment.
Company profile includes a documented HSE policy and capability records show multiple deployments in hospital/healthcare contexts, supporting safe execution at operational healthcare facilities.
Hospital IT project experience supports likely knowledge-transfer activities, but no explicit structured training/KT program is evidenced in the profile or capability summaries.
This is an evaluation rule/threshold applied by the procuring agency (not an evidentiary bidder requirement), so there is nothing to submit beyond aiming to score ≥70 technically.
